slideTypes.name: Standard Slide
slideTypes.description: Standard slide where blocks stack vertically.

slideTypes.name: Split Left Image
slideTypes.description: Left image, right content area. Requires 'image' string and 'imageSize' number (percentage 25-75).

slideTypes.name: Split Right Image
slideTypes.description: Right image, left content area. Requires 'image' string and 'imageSize' number (percentage 25-75).

slideTypes.name: Top Image Banner
slideTypes.description: Top image banner. Requires 'image' string and 'imageSize' number (height percentage 25-75).

slideTypes.name: Full Image
slideTypes.description: Full bleed background image. NO blocks allowed in this slide type.

bullets.name: Bullet Points
bullets.description: Standard lists or grids containing multiple sequential headers and descriptions.

types.name: Simple List
types.description: A classic vertical list of items, splitting into a 2-column layout when there are more than 4 items. Best for general text outlines and comprehensive summaries.

types.name: Bullets Grid
types.description: A structured grid of bullet items with headers and descriptions. Best for comparisons or scanning multiple parallel points at a glance.

types.name: Numbered List
types.description: A sequential list with prominent numbers instead of basic bullets. Best for step-by-step processes or top N lists.

types.name: Accent Bullets
types.description: A refined list where items are highlighted with horizontal accent bars.

cards.name: Card Layouts
cards.description: Grid or block cards to visually separate and present group data.

types.name: Basic Cards
types.description: Clean border-based card grid for showcasing features or items side-by-side cleanly.

types.name: Image Cards
types.description: Cards with a top placeholder area. Best for highlighting categorizations that need visual representation.

icons.name: Icon Layouts
icons.description: Visual layouts featuring prominent icons to represent concepts.

types.name: Icons List
types.description: A vertical list of items prominently featuring an icon on the left. Best for detailing specific features or steps.

types.name: Icons Grid
types.description: A structured grid of items prominently featuring a large icon for each. Best for visualizing abstract features or high-level business capabilities.

types.name: Icons Card
types.description: A structured grid of items prominently featuring a large icon for each. Best for visualizing abstract features or high-level business capabilities.

stats.name: Key Metrics & Statistics
stats.description: Large text indicators highlighting critical figures or metrics.

types.name: Stat Highlight
types.description: Emphasizes a single massive key metric with a detailed text callout description. Best for highlighting a monumental breakthrough metric.

types.name: Stats Grid
types.description: Grid display of big numbers and their descriptions. Best for dashboard summaries and showing multiple performance KPIs at once.

timelines.name: Timeline Layouts
timelines.description: Visual horizontal and vertical timeline tracks to represent milestones, project phases, or sequential stages.

types.name: Vertical Timeline
types.description: A vertical timeline track with nodes alternating left and right, complete with connector lines.

types.name: Horizontal Timeline
types.description: A horizontal timeline track with nodes alternating top and bottom, perfect for broad horizontal milestones.

types.name: Chevron Timeline
types.description: A horizontal sequence of connected chevron arrows with description text alternating top and bottom.

basic.name: Basic Blocks
basic.description: Essential structural blocks like text, images, tables, and code snippets.

types.name: Large Text
types.description: Large text perfect for main slide titles or big statements.

types.name: Plain Text
types.description: A clean, simple text paragraph layout for long-form descriptions or quotes.

types.name: Single Image
types.description: A single prominent image occupying maximum space, suitable for high-impact visual slides.

types.name: Image Gallery
types.description: A dynamic grid gallery displaying multiple images beautifully.

types.name: Table
types.description: A clean 2-column table layout perfect for comparing categories with their detailed descriptions.

types.name: Code Block
types.description: A preformatted code block for displaying source code.
